subject.title: [Bug]: Telegram partial-stream finalization lacks clear delivery-mode observability (sent vs preview-finalized vs canceled)

question: Should this Telegram-specific issue be resolved by rebasing/proving https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/84563, by replacing it with a fresh current-main Telegram PR, or by folding it into the broader durable delivery contract in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/87561?
rationale: Current source supports the Telegram-specific gap, but the remaining choice affects whether maintainers want a narrow channel repair now or a broader cross-channel delivery outcome contract first.

options.title: Rebase And Prove The Linked Telegram Fix
options.body: Keep this issue canonical, reconcile the linked PR with current main, and require real Telegram proof before closing.

options.title: Replace With A Fresh Telegram PR
options.body: Close or supersede the stale linked branch only after a current-main successor covers the same delayed-delivery and outcome-visibility behavior.

options.title: Fold Into The Cross-Channel Contract
options.body: Treat this as a Telegram evidence node under the broader durable final delivery semantics issue and defer channel-specific closure until that contract is designed.

recommendation.title: Rebase And Prove The Linked Telegram Fix
recommendation.body: Keep this issue canonical, reconcile the linked PR with current main, and require real Telegram proof before closing.

likelyOwner.reason: obviyus has the strongest recent history across the Telegram delivery and dispatch files that need the decision applied.
